sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. The league leaders currently sit 1st with 22 points from 10 games and will face struggling Alsager Town, who occupy bottom place with just 4 points. Sandbach then travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October at 15:00 in their second fixture of the week.
divisionWide: The opening Saturday (3 October) sees a congested fixture list with ten simultaneous 15:00 kick-offs across the division. Stafford Town (2nd, 20 points) host Dawley Town, while AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a match between sides near the top of the table. Wolverhampton Casuals visit Wednesfield Community in a local derby, with both sides in contention. Wolverhampton are in-form (W-W-W from their last three), while Wednesfield have won their last two. Mid-table Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir (11th), and fellow promotion hopefuls Barnton visit Shawbury United, who have lost their last six games. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a clash between mid-table sides, while bottom club Widnes Town visit Brereton Social in a basement battle. Crewe host Allscott Heath, with Allscott seeking five wins on the bounce and Crewe desperate to end a poor run. Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th) visit Sandbach United's neighbours Cheadle Heath in what appears to be a closely-fought lower-midtable contest. On Wednesday 7 October, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture. By Saturday 10 October, focus shifts to another full programme: Allscott Heath (targeting five consecutive wins) welcome Brereton Social, while Bilston Town host Crewe and Stafford Town travel to Wednesfield Community. Telford Town (19th, 6 points) face New Mills in a lower-half fixture, and Barnton host Dawley Town as the title race develops across the division.
